name: Old Fashioned
description: The original cocktail: whisky, sugar, bitters and a twist of orange. Simple, spirit-forward and timeless.
steps: Add the demerara syrup and bitters to a rocks glass and stir.
Add the bourbon and one large ice cube, then stir for 20 seconds.
Express an orange twist over the glass and drop it in.

name: Negroni
description: Equal parts gin, Campari and red vermouth. A bittersweet Italian aperitivo classic.
steps: Add the gin, Campari and red vermouth to a mixing glass filled with ice.
Stir for 30 seconds until well chilled.
Strain over one large ice cube in a rocks glass.
Express an orange twist over the drink and drop it in.

name: Martini
description: Gin and dry vermouth with a couple dashes of orange bitters, stirred ice cold. The king of cocktails.
steps: Chill a martini glass with ice water.
Add the gin, dry vermouth and orange bitters to a mixing glass filled with ice and stir for 30 seconds.
Strain into the chilled glass.

name: Daiquiri
description: White rum, lemon and sugar shaken hard. A Cuban classic and a benchmark for any bartender.
steps: Add the rum, lemon juice and simple syrup to a shaker filled with ice.
Shake hard for 12 seconds.
Double strain into a chilled coupe.

name: Whisky Sour
description: Whisky, lemon and sugar, shaken with egg white for a silky foam.
steps: Add everything to a shaker without ice and dry shake for 10 seconds to build the foam.
Add ice and shake hard for 12 seconds.
Strain into a rocks glass over fresh ice.

name: Margarita
description: Tequila, orange liqueur and lime served in a salt-rimmed glass. Bright, tart and refreshing.
steps: Wet half the rim of a rocks glass with lime and dip it in salt.
Add the tequila, triple sec and lime juice to a shaker filled with ice and shake for 12 seconds.
Strain over fresh ice.

name: Mojito
description: Cuban highball of white rum, lime, sugar and fresh mint, topped with soda water.
steps: Gently press the mint with the sugar and lime juice in a highball glass.
Add the rum and fill the glass with crushed ice, then stir to dissolve the sugar.
Top with the sparkling water and stir gently to lift the mint.

name: Manhattan
description: Rye whisky and red vermouth with a dash of bitters, stirred and served up. Rich and elegant.
steps: Add the rye, red vermouth and bitters to a mixing glass filled with ice.
Stir for 30 seconds until well chilled.
Strain into a chilled coupe.

name: Aviation
description: Pre-Prohibition gin sour with maraschino and violet, named for its pale sky-blue colour.
steps: Add the gin, maraschino liqueur, lemon juice and violet syrup to a shaker filled with ice.
Shake hard for 12 seconds.
Double strain into a chilled coupe.

name: Sidecar
description: Brandy, Cointreau and lemon. A 1920s classic sour with a sugared rim tradition.
steps: Wet the rim of a coupe with lemon and dip it in sugar.
Add the brandy, Cointreau and lemon juice to a shaker filled with ice.
Shake hard for 12 seconds.
Strain into the sugar-rimmed coupe.
Express a lemon twist over the drink and drop it in.

name: White Lady
description: Gin, triple sec and lemon, optionally shaken with egg white. Crisp, citrusy and smooth.
steps: Wet the rim of a coupe with lemon and dip it in sugar.
If using egg white, add everything to a shaker without ice and shake for 10 seconds.
Add ice and shake hard for 12 seconds.
Double strain into the sugar-rimmed coupe.

name: Black Russian
description: Vodka and coffee liqueur over ice. Simple, strong and sweet.
steps: Fill a rocks glass with ice.
Add the vodka and coffee liqueur and stir gently.

name: White Russian
description: A Black Russian topped with cream, made famous by The Big Lebowski.
steps: Fill a rocks glass with ice.
Add the vodka and coffee liqueur and stir.
Float the cream on top and give it one light stir.

name: Espresso Martini
description: Vodka, coffee liqueur and fresh espresso shaken to a velvety foam. Wakes you up, then messes you up.
steps: Brew the coffee and let it cool for a minute.
Add the vodka, coffee liqueur, coffee and simple syrup to a shaker filled with ice.
Shake hard for 15 seconds to build a foam.
Double strain into a chilled coupe.

name: Paloma
description: Mexico's favourite tequila highball, with grapefruit, lime and a pinch of salt.
steps: If you want a salted rim, wet half the rim of a highball glass with lime and dip it in salt.
Fill the glass with ice and add the tequila, grapefruit juice and lime juice.
Top with the sparkling water and stir gently.

name: Bees Knees
description: A Prohibition-era gin sour sweetened with honey.
steps: Stir the honey syrup and lemon juice together in a shaker until combined.
Add the gin and ice and shake hard for 12 seconds.
Double strain into a chilled coupe.

name: Southside
description: Gin, lime, sugar and mint shaken and served up. Think of a mojito made with gin.
steps: Lightly press the mint with the simple syrup in a shaker.
Add the gin, lime juice and ice and shake hard for 12 seconds.
Double strain into a chilled coupe.

name: Tequila Sunrise
description: Tequila and orange juice with grenadine sinking to the bottom for a sunrise effect.
steps: Fill a highball glass with ice.
Add the tequila and orange juice and stir.
Pour the grenadine slowly down the side of the glass so it sinks. Do not stir.

name: Pina Colada
description: Rum, coconut cream and pineapple. The tropical vacation in a glass from Puerto Rico.
steps: Add the rum, creme of coconut, pineapple juice and a scoop of crushed ice to a blender.
Blend until smooth.
Pour into a chilled hurricane glass.

name: Dark 'n' Stormy
description: Dark rum floated over spicy ginger beer with a squeeze of lime.
steps: Fill a highball glass with ice.
Add the lime juice, demerara syrup and ginger beer, then stir.
Float the dark rum on top.

name: B&B
description: Brandy and Benedictine in equal parts. A smooth, honeyed after-dinner sipper.
steps: Add the brandy and Benedictine to a mixing glass filled with ice.
Stir until chilled and strain into a rocks glass over fresh ice.

name: Earl Grey MarTEAni
description: Earl Grey infused gin shaken with lemon, demerara and egg white. A silky, tea-scented sour from Audrey Saunders.
steps: Add all ingredients to a shaker and dry shake without ice to build the foam.
Add ice and shake hard until well chilled.
Double strain into a chilled coupe.

name: Coffee Martini
description: Vodka, coffee liqueur and fresh coffee shaken to a frothy finish. A no-sugar-added cousin of the Espresso Martini.
steps: Add all ingredients to a shaker filled with ice.
Shake hard until a thick foam forms.
Double strain into a chilled coupe.

name: Toasted Almond
description: Amaretto, coffee liqueur and cream, with optional vodka for extra kick. Tastes like a nutty iced latte.
steps: Add all ingredients to a shaker filled with ice.
Shake until well chilled.
Strain into a rocks glass over fresh ice.

name: Blue Hawaii
description: Rum, vodka, blue curacao and pineapple. A bright blue tiki classic from the Hilton Hawaiian Village.
steps: Add all ingredients to a shaker filled with ice.
Shake until well chilled.
Strain into a hurricane glass over crushed ice.

name: Blue Hawaiian
description: Rum, coconut liqueur, blue curacao and pineapple. A blue, coconutty spin on the Pina Colada.
steps: Add all ingredients to a shaker filled with ice.
Shake until well chilled.
Strain into a hurricane glass over crushed ice.

name: Blue Lagoon
description: Vodka and blue curacao with lemon, lengthened with soda. Electric blue and easy drinking.
steps: Add the vodka, blue curacao, simple syrup and lemon juice to a highball glass filled with ice.
Top with sparkling water and stir gently.

name: Blue Ocean
description: Vodka and blue curacao balanced with grapefruit. Tart, slightly bitter and very blue.
steps: Add all ingredients to a shaker filled with ice.
Shake until well chilled.
Strain into a chilled coupe.

name: Blue Kamikaze
description: Equal parts vodka, blue curacao and lime. A sharp, sweet-and-sour party drink.
steps: Add all ingredients to a shaker filled with ice.
Shake until well chilled.
Strain into a chilled coupe or shot glasses.

name: Godfather
description: Scotch softened with amaretto. A simple, nutty two-ingredient sipper.
steps: Add the whisky and amaretto to a rocks glass with one large ice cube.
Stir gently until chilled.

name: Godmother
description: The Godfather with vodka instead of whisky. Sweet, smooth and almondy.
steps: Add the vodka and amaretto to a rocks glass with one large ice cube.
Stir gently until chilled.

name: Trinidad Sour
description: A full ounce of Angostura bitters as the base, tamed with orgeat, lemon and a splash of whisky. Bold, spicy and surprisingly balanced.
steps: Add all ingredients except the mint to a shaker filled with ice.
Shake until well chilled.
Strain into a chilled coupe and garnish with mint leaves.

name: Kevert soda (microwaved)
description: A house meme: a shot of Kevert and sparkling water in a plastic cup, microwaved for half a minute. Do not try this at home. Or do.
steps: Pour the Kevert and sparkling water into a plastic cup.
Microwave for 30 seconds.
Serve immediately, with no regrets.

name: Mai Tai
description: Rum, lime, orgeat and orange liqueur. The definitive tiki cocktail from Trader Vic.
steps: Add all ingredients except the mint to a shaker filled with ice.
Shake until well chilled.
Strain into a rocks glass over crushed ice and garnish with mint.

name: Vodka Paloma
description: A Paloma made with vodka: grapefruit, lime and soda for a light, tart highball.
steps: Add the vodka, grapefruit juice, lime juice and simple syrup to a highball glass filled with ice.
Top with sparkling water and stir gently.

name: Dark Daiquiri
description: A Daiquiri made with dark rum and demerara syrup. Richer, rounder and more molasses-forward.
steps: Add all ingredients to a shaker filled with ice.
Shake hard until well chilled.
Double strain into a chilled coupe.

name: Ivy Gimlet
description: Vodka, lime and sugar shaken with fresh mint. Bright, green and refreshing.
steps: Gently muddle the mint with the simple syrup in a shaker.
Add the vodka, lime juice and ice, then shake until well chilled.
Double strain into a chilled coupe.

name: Eastside
description: A Southside with muddled cucumber. Cool, herbal and crisp.
steps: Muddle the cucumber slices in a shaker, then add the mint and press gently.
Add the gin, lime juice, simple syrup and ice, then shake until well chilled.
Double strain into a chilled coupe.

name: Hades' Ambrosia
description: Dark rum sweetened with honey, elderflower and Benedictine, finished with grated cinnamon and tonka bean. Rich, warm and aromatic.
steps: Add the rum, honey syrup, elderflower liqueur, Benedictine and lemon juice to a mixing glass filled with ice.
Stir until well chilled and strain into a rocks glass over one large ice cube.
Grate cinnamon and tonka bean over the top.

name: Dune's Spice Coffee
description: Hot coffee spiked with rye and coffee liqueur, sweetened with the spice syrup and topped with whipped cream. The spice must flow.
steps: Add the rye whisky, coffee liqueur and spice syrup to a warmed glass mug.
Top with hot coffee and stir.
Float the whipped cream on top.

name: Between the Sheets
description: A Sidecar with a splash of white rum. Boozy, citrusy and a little cheeky.
steps: Add all ingredients to a shaker filled with ice.
Shake until well chilled.
Strain into a chilled coupe.

name: Champagne Cocktail
description: A bitters-soaked sugar cube topped with champagne and an optional splash of brandy. Elegant and effervescent.
steps: Place the sugar cube in a champagne flute and soak it with the bitters.
Add the brandy, if using.
Slowly top with chilled champagne.

name: Black Velvet
description: Guinness and champagne layered in equal parts. Dark, creamy and dry.
steps: Pour the champagne into a flute.
Slowly layer the Guinness on top over the back of a spoon.
